stage: Authored state, migration and collection contracts before learner rendering
reviewedBehaviours: Every registered response, choice and flag has one activity owner and a declared return target.
Ordinary and Unicode maximum active-field fixtures fit44000; escaped and mixed legacy overflows reject without truncating writing or replacing last valid payloads.
Flags use a fingerprinted bitset. Existing token arrays still decode; unknown map identities and unused high bits reject. Writing limits and choice meanings are unchanged.
All legacy schema IDs have explicit preserve-only dispositions; no former completion or answer is assigned to a different new activity.

Five source shapes are supported: compact-v2, full state-v1, shell responses, completion arrays and note arrays. All original bytes are verified in separate backups before any new payload is produced.
Readable legacy presentation keeps duplicate pairs and unknown data; original raw bytes remain separately available.

Collection includes meaningful drafts, selected canonical choices, wrong/zero graph values, attempts, saved work and earlier work. Full Copy/Print text cannot accept a filtered partial activity index.
Required43-route completion depends on its specified attempts, saved Evidence Slip/media checkpoint or seminar. Optional textbook, Advanced and collection work does not change required completion.
Local storage, LMS SetValue and Commit outcomes remain separately reported by tested engine stubs.
remaining: Real browser storage, denied quota, provider failure, reload, focus return and collection controls
